type codingagent.ModelInfo struct
fields:
- ContextWindow int64 tag=""
- ID string tag=""
- Provider string tag=""
- Reasoning bool tag=""
type codingagent.ModelCycleResult struct
fields:
- IsScoped bool tag=""

- ThinkingLevel ai.ModelThinkingLevel tag=""
type codingagent.BashResult struct
fields:
- Output string tag=""

- Cancelled bool tag=""
- Truncated bool tag=""
- FullOutputPath *string tag=""

fields:
- AssistantMessages int tag=""

- UserMessages int tag=""
- ContextUsage *codingagent.ContextUsage tag=""
- Cost float64 tag=""

- SessionID string tag=""
- Tokens ai.Usage tag=""
